Pro:
Encounters are more interesting than the first game

Cons:
Runs like ass on a near top-tier rig
Looks like ♥♥♥♥
Can't adjust mouse sensitivity in game, have to adjust DPI or Windows mouse speed.
Controllers will make the game lag after 1.5hrs
Gameplay is made to be as obnoxious as possible with stupid design decisions, unnecessary AOE attacks in areas you would never see while fighting bosses
Arbitrary insta-kill attacks/traps
Form what I remember of the first game, gameplay is much slower
Dungeon segments are still easily discernible
Arbitrary puzzles for no reason
Some weapon types are completely useless against some enemies/bosses

Way more reliant on replaying than the first game
Main "enemy" of the game doesn't even exist outside the prologue and ending

TLDR;Buy on sale with the DLCs, Great aesthetics/visuals/sounds, great new classes and weapons, Fun boss fights, good replayability, non-existent communications (making public matchmaking not as friendly as the first one)

Other than the non-existent communication system that isnt the ping system or the [spoiler]the frustratingly designed Labyrinth Sentinel "fight"[/spoiler], I think the sequel is a good followup to Remnant from the Ashes. What I do miss from the first game tho was the Armour set bonuses which you do not get in the second game but I do understand that it probably is because of the new additions they had added to the game that is related to the classes and certain items. Some stuff does start to feel redundant after awhile but the replayability is still there and I'm glad the aesthetics remained constant throughout from the first game to now. I'm also glad DLC share is a thing even though the Game(and DLCs) go on sale quite a bit ( just be warned, the person without the dlc cannot use the DLC-related items that can be gained)
